# awesome-prediction-market-toolkit

> A curated, maintained list of prediction market tools: odds, volume and wallet tracking, execution, alerts, data and APIs, and leverage, lending and yield, across Polymarket, Kalshi, and others. Maintained by Predictbook.

## What this is
Each entry is a real, vetted tool, not a marketing pitch. Entries include what the tool is best for, team, pricing, and phase (live/beta). See CONTRIBUTING.md for how entries get added and vetted.

## Categories
- Cross-Platform Odds Aggregators
- Trade Copying & Automation
- Trading Terminals & Execution
- Signal & Fair-Value
- Wallet & Trader Analytics
- Alerts & Whale Monitoring
- Research & Market Discovery
- Leverage, Lending & Yield
